💡 Part 1
Two Levels of AI and Guardrails
人工智能的两个层次与安全守则
65 minutes ⏱️
9
💬 Level 1: Generative AI 生成式人工智能
Generative AI creates. Humans review, personalise, and decide.
  • Write a caption about a family meal
  • Draft a script about a recent trip
  • Simplify a long article into three easy points
Try: "Give me 3 warm captions for TikTok or Instagram about a family dinner. Under 40 words. Add 3 simple hashtags."
10
🤖 Level 2: Agentic AI 能分步骤完成任务的人工智能
Agentic AI helps with steps, not just sentences.
  • Plans a full TikTok or Instagram content plan
  • Turns one family recipe into a caption, talking points and script
  • Organises trip ideas into a simple itinerary
Try: "Help me plan the hook, script, captions, hashtags and simple editing steps for one video about my recent trip."
11
🛡️ Guardrails 安全守则
  • 🔒 Keep private information private: NRIC, bank details, passwords 个人资料不外泄
  • 🙋 Ask before posting other people 发布他人前先征得同意
  • 🎭 AI faces and voices can look real: be careful 小心逼真的AI人像与声音
  • ✅ Check important facts before posting 重要事实先核实
  • 🛑 Never give AI full control of accounts, payments or messages 不要让AI全权控制账户
12

📤 Post or save as draft 发布或存草稿
Safe posting checklist 安全发布清单
  • No home address, car plate, medical or bank details
  • No other people without permission 未经同意不发布他人
  • Use the app's own music and effects
  • Check the video and caption before posting 发布前再检查
